releaseNotes: AURA 3.3.0 introduces AURA Link: connect stems for deep per-stem analysis with zero routing, in every DAW - drop AURA on a stem track and pick 'Send as: Kick'. Plus a stem-mapping overhaul (auto-labels, live levels, source badges), honest recommendations showing measured level vs target, GENRE TARGET and REF DELTA spectrum views, and a permanent fix for the garbled characters on Windows.
